description: Look up all common DNS records (A, AAAA, NS, MX, TXT, CNAME, SOA) for a domain. Returns results from a specified DNS server.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. example.com)

server.description: DNS server to query. Default: cloudflare. Use 'authoritative' for the domain's own nameservers.

name: dns_lookup
